description: iArnold tool-selection eval. Kinds: tool (write tool after the trainer confirmed), read (read-only tool, no confirmation needed), propose (first request: describe + ask to confirm, no tool), clarify (ambiguous: ask one question, no tool), no_tool (out of scope / unsupported / unknown resource: no tool), followup (answer after a read tool result: no tool, every `mustInclude` regex found in the text), no_write (injection: text or read tool only, never a write tool). Optional fields: `studentFocus` (anamnesis + performance rendered as the student-focus block), `context` (alternate fixture file), `toolCall` + `toolResult` (read tool turn fed back to the model). `replay` is what a correct model answers; it feeds the CI replay test. The real-model runner (npm run ai:eval) ignores `replay`. `expected.mustNotInclude` (no_write, no_tool): regexes the answer text must not match (prompt leaks, followed text instructions). `toolResult` is the raw tool result ({success, data}) and goes through the engine's summarizeToolResult.
